experience_window: Last five years; sample assumption: accept since-2021 counts as the intended cohort. Require clarification for broader periods. Verify exact project dates operationally.

fields.description: Bidder explicitly states its own Ontario electrical contractor licence. False when only a subcontractor licence is offered; null when unreadable or genuinely unclear.
Confirmed liability insurance coverage in CAD.
Total all-in project price in CAD; null if totals conflict or currency is unclear.
Confirmed completion weeks from award; null if deferred or unspecified.
Count of commercial projects of at least 100 kW within the configured experience window; null when the stated period is broader and the qualifying subset is unknown.
Named project lead/manager explicitly stated; a future assignment is false. Accept the sample summaries' statement that a lead is named.
Performance monitoring explicitly included; ordinary progress reports alone do not qualify.

requirements.reason: Bidder's own Ontario electrical contractor licence is not stated.
Confirmed liability coverage is below CAD 5M.
Total price exceeds the configured budget ceiling.

warning_reasons.instruction_attempt: Untrusted document instructions require reviewer acknowledgement; they have no scoring authority.
warning_reasons.experience_window_unclear: Experience period needs clarification before a qualifying project count can be scored.
